title: Volcanoes! Vocabulary Cards, Graphic Organizers, and Vocabulary Test (K-3rd Grade)

overview.description: A 12-page vocabulary study set for a volcano science unit. Three components: (1) vocabulary cards (word + part of speech + definition, 4 per page), (2) graphic organizer ('Word + Draw a Picture' two-column table), (3) definition-matching vocabulary test with answer key. Two Lexile levels: 520L (K-1st) and 630L (2nd-3rd). Standards-aligned (RI.4).
components: Vocabulary Graphic Organizer (write word + draw picture)

vocabularyCardFormat.description: Each card: word in large font (left) + part of speech + definition (right). Clean, two-column layout. 4 cards per page with cut lines. Designed for cutting, laminating, and reuse.
vocabularyCardFormat.value: Portable vocabulary study. Cards can be used for matching games, flash-card review, or pocket-chart activities.

drawAPictureOrganizer.description: Two-column graphic organizer: 'Word' (left) + 'Draw a Picture' (right). 'Write down the vocabulary words and draw a picture to help you remember what the word means.' The child processes the word VISUALLY, not just linguistically.
drawAPictureOrganizer.value: Dual coding — word + image = stronger memory. The child's own drawing is more memorable than someone else's illustration.

leveledAssessment.description: Vocabulary test comes in two Lexile levels: 520L (K-1st grade) and 630L (2nd-3rd grade). Same words, different sentence complexity in the definitions. Answer key included.
leveledAssessment.value: Differentiation. Same test, two reading levels. Matches Carolyng's interest in leveled materials from the Harcourt drops.

standardsAlignment.description: Pages marked with RI.4 (Common Core Reading Informational Text Standard 4 — determining word meaning from context). Shows which standard each activity addresses.

gaps.name: vocabulary-study-set
gaps.description: A three-part vocabulary companion for any science/social studies unit: (1) vocabulary cards (word + part of speech + definition, cut-out format), (2) 'Word + Draw a Picture' graphic organizer (child processes each word visually), (3) definition-matching vocabulary test at 2 reading levels + answer key. Generatable for ANY unit topic.

notes: This completes a pattern visible across Aless's drops: she values vocabulary/nomenclature as a SYSTEM, not just word lists. Montessori nomenclature cards (image-based, self-correcting), vocabulary flash cards (text-based, definition-focused), and now this vocabulary study set (cards + graphic organizer + assessment). Three different approaches to vocabulary learning, all with the same underlying principle: encounter each word multiple times in multiple modes.
